macros.name: aref
macros.doc: \aref{⟨labels...⟩} writes the whole reference: every level down \Aref to the one named, in the order and the wording the language asks for.

macros.name: attachdocument
macros.doc: Attaches any file by its ⟨filename⟩, without an artifact of its own, with ⟨description⟩ as the description of the attachment.

macros.name: autocitedefs
macros.doc: Marks every occurrence of the name of a definition in the text that follows, without the text having to say so.

macros.name: describe
macros.doc: Prints the description of a single definition and marks it as the anchor of that definition, so hyperlinks of \gls end up at the right spot.

macros.name: documentattachment
macros.doc: Attaches the file of artifact ⟨label⟩ and prints ⟨link text⟩ as the link to it.

macros.name: documentfootnote
macros.doc: Places the footnote of the first occurrence of a reference or a definition of another document, with the document itself attached to it.

macros.name: loadglsdefs
macros.doc: Loads the definitions of ⟨src⟩ under the definitions type.

macros.name: newdefinition
macros.doc: Declares one definition in the document itself, under the definitions type and the defs category, so that it lands in the same list as the ones read from a file.

macros.name: newsource
macros.doc: Declares one source in the document itself, which is the route that needs no file at all.

macros.name: Nref
macros.doc: Refers with the designation and the number, in the order the language prescribes.

macros.name: printdefs
macros.doc: \printdefs{⟨width of text⟩} prints the definition list.

macros.name: refdocument
macros.doc: Declares another regulatory document to refer to, of which the labels are read with \zexternaldocument of zref-xr and prefixed with ⟨prefix⟩.

macros.name: RegulatoryLoadLanguage
macros.doc: Loads the definition file of ⟨language⟩, unless it is already loaded.

macros.name: regulatorysetup
macros.doc: Sets the same keys after the package is loaded, and is what a regulatory.cfg writes.

macros.name: setjuncto
macros.doc: \setjuncto makes the last conjunction ‘ jo.\ ’ from that point on, and \unsetjuncto puts ‘ and ’ back.

macros.name: signaturefield
macros.doc: Draws a signature field of ⟨width⟩ by ⟨height⟩ under the name ⟨name⟩, which is the name a viewer stores the signature under and the one a signing tool asks for.

macros.name: srcfield
macros.doc: Reads one field of a source.

macros.name: srcref
macros.doc: Cites a source, either as a whole or down to one of its provisions.

macros.name: unsetjuncto
macros.doc: \setjuncto makes the last conjunction ‘ jo.\ ’ from that point on, and \unsetjuncto puts ‘ and ’ back.

envs.name: paras
envs.doc: The paras environment holds the two levels below an article, built with enumitem.

envs.name: provisions
envs.doc: The provisions environment is a flat enumeration, numbered within the \section it stands in rather than within an article, for a text that has one level and no headings of its own.
